messages.content: 在一場撲克遊戲中，確定贏家是誰，約翰手中有8♥、10♥、J♥、Q♥、K♥，邁克手中有9♠、J♠、10♠、Q♠、K♠。

function.name: card_games_poker_determine_winner
function.description: Determines the winner in a game of Poker based on the cards in each players' hands. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

hand1.description: The list of cards (as strings) in first player's hand. E.g ['10♠', 'J♠']

hand2.description: The list of cards (as strings) in second player's hand. E.g ['9♥', '10♥']

message.content:
邁克贏了。  
邁克的手牌 9♠ 10♠ J♠ Q♠ K♠ 是一手順子同花（Straight Flush），而約翰的手牌 8♥ 10♥ J♥ Q♥ K♥ 雖然是同花，但並不是順子（缺少 9♥）。在撲克中，順子同花比同花更高，邁克的手牌勝過約翰。
message.reasoning: We need to determine winner. John has a straight flush: 8♥-10♥-J♥-Q♥-K♥. Mike has a straight flush: 9♠-10♠-J♠-Q♠-K♠. Straight flush with higher top card wins. Mike's top card is K♠, same as John's top card K♥. But the straight flush ranking: compare highest card; if tie, compare suits? In poker, suits are not ranked. So if both have same high card, it's a tie. But John's straight flush is 8-9-10-J-Q-K? Wait John's cards: 8♥,10♥,J♥,Q♥,K♥. That's missing 9♥. So it's not a straight flush? Actually a straight flush requires consecutive ranks. John's ranks: 8,10,J,Q,K. That's not consecutive because missing 9. So John's hand is not a straight flush. It's a flush (all hearts) but not straight. Mike's hand: 9♠,10♠,J♠,Q♠,K♠. That's 9-10-J-Q-K, which is a straight flush. So Mike wins. So answer: Mike wins.
